item.title: From Photos to Printable 3D
item.description: Building a local AI pipeline that turns photos into watertight, slicer-ready STLs on AMD hardware.

item.title: From Brackets to Enclosures
item.description: A Raspberry Pi 5 snap-fit enclosure puts blender-mcp-bridge through a more demanding agentic test. Claude and Codex successfully construct and verify base-and-lid geometry, while Google Antigravity takes a different path and generates Blender Python instead. The experiment highlights an important distinction: MCP provides the modeling capabilities, but each agent decides how to use them.

item.title: Bridging Digital and Physical Worlds
item.description: An exploration of the boundary between digital and physical fabrication. From first 3D prints to AI-driven Blender automation, this post examines how state management, deterministic workflows, bidirectional synchronization, and feedback loops shape reliable systems across both software and hardware.
